data.current_description:
Change resources use type `entity-change`. Snapshot fields are spread into
`attributes` alongside `changeType`, `changedKeys`, `mergedInto`, and `recordedAt`.
The `entity` relationship uses the domain type from the snapshot.

`meta.cursor` advances even when a filtered page is empty, so clients do not
re-scan the same non-matching window. `links.next` is present when another page
of matching changes may exist.

GFFS qualifier string. Free-text terms are rejected. Allowed fields: type, title, name, displayDate, jurisdiction, localIdentifier, localType, authority, status. Change metadata (changeType, changedKeys, recordedAt) is not filterable. Operators: equality / multi-value OR, `~` contains, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `..` ranges, and leading `-` negation (where valid). Filters apply to the post-change snapshot. Tombstones (empty entity) typically do not match.
data.summary_suggestion: Tail entity changes with GFFS filtering and cursor pagination
data.description_suggestion: Returns a paginated feed of entity changes ordered by recorded timestamp. Supports GFFS qualifier filtering on post-change snapshot fields (type, title, name, displayDate, jurisdiction, localIdentifier, localType, authority, status). Change metadata (changeType, changedKeys, recordedAt) cannot be filtered. Operators include equality, multi-value OR, contains (~), comparisons (>, >=, <, <=), ranges (..), and negation (-). Cursor-based pagination advances even on empty filtered pages to prevent re-scanning. Requires Bearer authentication. Returns EntityChangesDocument with entity-change resources, each containing snapshot attributes, changeType, changedKeys, mergedInto, and recordedAt.
